mapper.select: SELECT price_id, security_id, price_date, low_price, high_price, open_price, close_price, daily_return_rate, trading_volume, trading_value, created_at FROM security_daily_prices WHERE security_id = #{securityId} ORDER BY price_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE security_daily_prices SET low_price = #{lowPrice}, high_price = #{highPrice}, open_price = #{openPrice}, close_price = #{closePrice}, daily_return_rate = #{dailyReturnRate}, trading_volume = #{tradingVolume}, trading_value = #{tradingValue} WHERE price_id = #{priceId}
